clusters.headline: Tijjani Reijnders Scores Hat-Trick In Netherlands Seven Goal Win
aiSummaryBullets: Tijjani Reijnders scored three goals in the first half of the Nations League match.
The Netherlands secured a 7-0 victory against the Greece national team.

clusters.headline: Activists Enter Microsoft Data Center Construction Site In Amsterdam
aiSummaryBullets: Activists gained unauthorized access to a Microsoft data center construction site located in Amsterdam.
The incident is part of a coordinated series of protests spanning 16 European nations against the expansion of AI infrastructure.
